description: Save the session's workbook to the user's Library for durable storage. If the session was loaded from the Library or was previously saved, this creates a new version of that file. Otherwise it creates a new Library file. Each save is a named version in the Library's history: pass `message`, or it takes the latest commit_session message since the last save. commit_session checkpoints themselves stay in the session, so save after each step you want kept as a version. Returns {library_file_id, version_id, name, message, created, noop}; noop is true when nothing changed since the last version. Open the file again later with create_session's library_file_id; list_library_files finds it.

message.description: Name for this version in the Library, e.g. "23 — revised exit cap" (defaults to the latest commit_session message)

name.description: File name for a new Library file (defaults to the session's document label); not used when saving a new version

session_id.description: Session ID returned by create_session (list_sessions shows the open ones)

name: save_to_library
title: Save to Library
